scenes.text: Imagine walking into a library, picking up a beautiful old book, and suddenly finding yourself poisoned.
To warn the public about the dangers of arsenic-pigmented wallpaper, he bound eighty-six actual wallpaper samples into this book.
Today, only four copies survive, and anyone who wants to read them must wear heavy-duty protective gloves inside a sealed room.
Would you risk opening it? Hit that follow button and tell me in the comments.
